subcommands.name: complete-snapshot
subcommands.description: Seals and completes the snapshot after all of the required blocks of data have been written to it. Completing the snapshot changes the status to completed.

options.name: --snapshot-id
options.description: The ID of the snapshot

options.name: --changed-blocks-count
options.description: The number of blocks that were written to the snapshot

options.name: --checksum
options.description: An aggregated Base-64 SHA256 checksum based on the checksums of each written block.

options.name: --checksum-algorithm
options.description: The algorithm used to generate the checksum. Currently, the only supported algorithm is SHA256

options.name: --checksum-aggregation-method
options.description: The aggregation method used to generate the checksum. Currently, the only supported aggregation method is LINEAR

subcommands.name: get-snapshot-block
subcommands.description: Returns the data in a block in an Amazon Elastic Block Store snapshot.

options.name: --snapshot-id
options.description: The ID of the snapshot containing the block from which to get data.

options.name: --block-index
options.description: The block index of the block in which to read the data. A block index is a logical index in units of 512 KiB blocks.

options.name: --block-token
options.description: The block token of the block from which to get data. You can obtain the BlockToken by running the ListChangedBlocks or ListSnapshotBlocks operations

options.name: outfile
options.description: Filename where the content will be saved

subcommands.name: list-changed-blocks
subcommands.description: Returns information about the blocks that are different between two Amazon Elastic Block Store snapshots of the same volume/snapshot lineage.

options.name: --first-snapshot-id
options.description: The ID of the first snapshot to use for the comparison.

options.name: --second-snapshot-id
options.description: The ID of the second snapshot to use for the comparison.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: The token to request the next page of results. If you specify NextToken, then StartingBlockIndex is ignored

options.name: --max-results
options.description: The maximum number of blocks to be returned by the request.

options.name: --starting-block-index
options.description: The block index from which the comparison should start.

subcommands.description: Returns information about the blocks in an Amazon Elastic Block Store snapshot.

options.name: --snapshot-id

options.name: --next-token

options.name: --starting-block-index

subcommands.name: put-snapshot-block
subcommands.description: Writes a block of data to a snapshot. If the specified block contains data, the existing data is overwritten. The target snapshot must be in the pending state.

options.name: --snapshot-id
options.description: The ID of the snapshot.  If the specified snapshot is encrypted, you must have permission to use the KMS key that was used to encrypt the snapshot.

options.name: --block-index
options.description: The block index of the block in which to write the data. A block index is a logical index in units of 512 KiB blocks.

options.name: --block-data
options.description: The data to write to the block. The block data is not signed as part of the Signature Version 4 signing process.

options.name: --data-length
options.description: The size of the data to write to the block, in bytes. Currently, the only supported size is 524288 bytes. Valid values: 524288

options.name: --progress
options.description: The progress of the write process, as a percentage

options.name: --checksum
options.description: A Base64-encoded SHA256 checksum of the data. Only SHA256 checksums are supported

options.name: --checksum-algorithm
options.description: The algorithm used to generate the checksum. Currently, the only supported algorithm is SHA256

subcommands.name: start-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon EBS snapshot. The new snapshot enters the pending state after the request completes.

options.name: --volume-size
options.description: The size of the volume, in GiB. The maximum size is 65536 GiB (64 TiB)

options.name: --parent-snapshot-id
options.description: The ID of the parent snapshot. If there is no parent snapshot, or if you are creating the first snapshot for an on-premises volume, omit this parameter.

options.name: --tags
options.description: The tags to apply to the snapshot

options.name: --description
options.description: A description for the snapshot

options.name: --client-token
options.description: A unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request. Idempotency ensures that an API request completes only once.

options.name: --encrypted
options.description: Indicates whether to encrypt the snapshot. You can't specify Encrypted and  ParentSnapshotId in the same request.

options.name: --no-encrypted
options.description: Indicates whether to encrypt the snapshot. You can't specify Encrypted and  ParentSnapshotId in the same request.

options.name: --kms-key-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Key Management Service (KMS) key to be used to encrypt the snapshot.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: The amount of time (in minutes) after which the snapshot is automatically cancelled if:   No blocks are written to the snapshot.
